              A Japanese single cask from Karuizawa distillery that used to be located in Miyota, a town near active the volcano, Mount Asama. It was mothballed in 2000. This bottling was distilled in 1992 and matured until 2007 in an American white oak sherry butt.

              Bought from a private collection. Further detail photos can be requested by emailing us.

              Shipping and delivery

              Order before 2pm on a working day and we’ll dispatch your order the same day, with next working day delivery across the UK.

              UK delivery is free on orders over £100. For international orders, delivery costs are calculated at checkout based on your destination.

              You’ll find all the details, including delivery rates and destinations, on our Delivery & Returns page.

              Billing

              We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Payment is taken securely when you place your order.

              Our prices include UK VAT where applicable. We also show the ex-VAT price alongside the main price, so our trade and export customers can easily see both.

              Returns

              Changed your mind? No problem. You have 14 days from delivery to let us know you'd like to return your order. 

              Please take care when handling and packaging your return, as the condition of the product and its packaging can affect the amount we’re able to refund. If your order arrives damaged or faulty, please get in touch with us and we’ll put things right.

              For the full details, see our Terms and Conditions.

              Our Stores

              Prefer to pick up your whisky? Click & Collect is free from either of our Edinburgh shops - Royal Mile Whiskies or Drinkmonger in Bruntsfield.

              Choose Click & Collect at checkout and we’ll email you as soon as your order is ready to collect. You can find opening hours, addresses and directions on Our Shops.
